report.body:
San Antonio stay on top at 13-3, with LA Lakers right behind at 13-3.

Chicago made the week’s biggest leap; Golden State took the sharpest tumble.

Player of the Week: Giannis Antetokounmpo averaged 32.7 points, 12.3 rebounds and 6.3 assists across 3 games.
